purpose: Canonical machine-readable plugin library for agent use. This file prioritizes structured retrieval, visual plugin-encyclopedia coverage, current-family posture, thumbnail asset paths, and a clear separation between official specs and subjective consensus.
scope: Seeded flagship library for plugin-specific queries. Use this first for structured retrieval, then load the narrative companions for deeper commentary and broader long-tail coverage.

visual_dictionary_contract.goal: This should become a visual encyclopedia of audio plugins. Every mature entry should expose a recognizable plugin GUI image, not just a generic icon.
visual_dictionary_contract.llm_instruction: If an entry still uses a local AU bundle icon, treat that as a temporary seed asset. Try to upgrade it to an official vendor GUI screenshot first; if that is not practical and the plugin is installed locally, capture the GUI from FXControl and replace the seed asset.

source_model.official_specs_policy: Specs, current-family status, and format/platform posture should be checked against current vendor product pages or manuals.
source_model.subjective_policy: Subjective fields summarize recurring engineer, forum, and creator language. Treat them as SUBJECTIVE or PRACTICE, never as standards.
source_model.youtube_policy: Use the search seeds in each entry to gather current creator coverage. Do not treat any single creator video as authoritative.
source_model.local_asset_policy: Local AU component bundle icons are acceptable only as temporary seed assets while the visual encyclopedia is being built out.
source_model.fxcontrol_policy: If an official GUI image is not already captured, prefer a later capture from FXControl's live plugin view over leaving the entry on a generic component icon.
source_model.schema_policy: When enriching or promoting an entry, normalize it against audio-bible-plugin-entry-schema.json so official facts, subjective consensus, visuals, and local observations keep the same field shape.
